text: 在人民银行上海总部的指导下，农业银行上海市分行依托上海电子凭证会计数据服务平台和中征应收账款融资服务平台，成功为上海两家小微企业发放流动资金贷款750万元，实现全市首批增信会计数据线上贷款落地。（上证报）
text_en: Under the guidance of the PBOC Shanghai Headquarters, the Shanghai branch of Agricultural Bank of China, relying on the Shanghai electronic voucher accounting data service platform and the Zhongzheng accounts receivable financing service platform, successfully issued working capital loans of 7.5 million yuan to two small and micro enterprises in Shanghai, realizing the city's first batch of credit-enhanced accounting data online loans. (Shanghai Securities News)
